tier_definition: Depends only on Qt and possibly third-party libraries; no dependency on another KDE Framework.

evidence.cause: dpkg-buildpackage -S invoked debian/rules clean on the host and dh could not load dh-sequence-kf6; build helpers belong in the clean sbuild environment

KDE 6.30 exposed libstdc++ _ZSt19piecewise_construct as an implementation/toolchain symbol; dpkg-gensymbols assigned the package revision 6.30.0-0supralinux1 as its minimum version and Lintian rejected the resulting symbols entry.
Ubuntu 6.24 symbols baseline still required two KCharsets constructors already removed from the newer Debian 6.28 reference.
15 new libstdc++ std::format/Unicode implementation symbols received a Debian-revision minimum version and required reviewed optional=toolchain tagging at upstream 6.30.0.
The binary build succeeded, but absent Multi-Arch was normalized incorrectly and the watch signing key was missing.
ECMPoQmTools required Qt6 LinguistTools during configure, but qt6-tools-dev was missing from Build-Depends.
ECMPoQmTools required Qt6 LinguistTools during configure, but qt6-tools-dev was missing from Build-Depends.
src/kx11extras.cpp includes xcb/xfixes.h, but libxcb-xfixes0-dev was omitted from Build-Depends; both retained Debian 6.28 and Ubuntu 6.24 packaging references declare that development provider.

Compilation succeeded after adding libxcb-xfixes0-dev, but NETWM-dependent X11 suites failed under bare Xvfb because no window manager was running. KDE upstream kwindowinfox11test.cpp documents OpenBox as the window manager used by build.kde.org.

OpenBox became ready and the Wayland suite passed, but dh_auto_test inherited parallel=4 and ran X11 suites concurrently against the same Xvfb/OpenBox root state. kwindoweffectstest failed a compositor-selection signal count and kwindowsystemx11test received two activeWindowChanged signals where upstream expects one; the failures are consistent with cross-suite X11 state interference rather than a KDE source, provider or ABI failure.

The serial X11 remediation succeeded: all 14 CTest suites passed, sbuild completed successfully and the Lintian error gate passed. The consumer then failed to dlopen libKF6WindowSystem because libxcb-res.so.0 was absent from the hosted runner. The built libkf6windowsystem6 package correctly Depends on libxcb-res0 (>= 1.10), and readelf records libxcb-res.so.0 as NEEDED; the old consumer-root runner extracted only the built Batch 6 .debs and never installed their external runtime Depends.
dpkg-gensymbols added _ZSt19piecewise_construct@Base at the current Debian revision; Lintian rejected symbols-file-contains-current-version-with-debian-revision.

The hash-locked symbols transform succeeded, but debian/rules invokes python3 without declaring python3:any (or an equivalent Python build prerequisite); Lintian rejected rules-require-build-prerequisite.

The package built and all 5 tests passed, but dpkg-gensymbols added _ZSt19piecewise_construct@Base at the current Debian revision and Lintian rejected symbols-file-contains-current-version-with-debian-revision.
The binary build succeeded, but absent Multi-Arch was normalized incorrectly and the watch signing key was missing.
